model.admission: One perceived living corporeal creature within120ft/LoE with complete body/equipment bounds, supported original footprint and room for the selected cell; unwilling target receives the selected mode's save vs the caster's actual spell DC. Willing target may explicitly decline. No forced confinement for unsupported/partial/colliding formation; known illegal geometry fails before commitment, newly invalid geometry after commitment fails paid.

commonCell.innerBounds: target current whole body plus carried equipment AABB, expanded1ft in X/Y and1ft above. Floor stays at original feetZ and uses an existing continuous supported floor; no slab is inserted through terrain.
commonCell.walls: four side panels thickness0.5ft and one ceiling thickness0.5ft, outside the inner bounds. Allocate corners to X-panels; Y-panels span only inner X to avoid positive-volume overlaps. Each panel has a stable source-owned ID, exact AABB and independent HP where relevant.
commonCell.needs: air/light/sound pass; no oxygen, food, water, sleep or aging suspension. Body retains awareness, hands/components, equipment, actions, needs, injury and death processes. It is not stunned or deprived of its whole Action.
commonCell.boundary: solid against ordinary movement and objects while active; no new anti-teleport, anti-planar or anti-incorporeal privilege beyond the chosen creature admission. Any external escape ability must satisfy its own permission.
commonCell.privacy: cell is visible; private release keys/mental content are not disclosed by exterior inspection

STONE_VAULT.panelDamage: ordinary source-authorized object damage; no automatic immunity or resistance
STONE_VAULT.escape: a creature/helper spends actual attack/tool Actions with range and LoE. A destroyed panel is permanently absent, opening that exact region; it is not regenerated. Whole-body fit through the gap still required.
STONE_VAULT.substance: source-owned conjured stone, rank9 ongoing expression; no loot or reusable mineral value; fragments are source-owned nonrecoverable residue and vanish at source ending

SIGIL_CELL.physicalDamage: not a physical destructible object; ordinary attacks cannot damage its magical boundary
SIGIL_CELL.escape: imprisoned actor spends one Action for one WIS save vs original cast DC; three successes cumulatively terminate the source, failures do not erase successes. Helpers may perform actual eligible rank9 dispel or use the source's registered release key; no free check each turn.
SIGIL_CELL.key: caster names one finite explicit known release condition at declaration: target states a recorded passphrase and spends an Action. In fixtures the target knows it only after helper communicates it; no secret knowledge is inferred.

lifecycle.printedInstantaneous: formation only; NEW continuing prison expression with finite deadline
lifecycle.ownerLoss: source survives caster incapacity/death until existing ending/deadline; owner may dismiss using one Action if alive and able, no distance or plane communication override beyond same-plane known source ID
lifecycle.endings: 24-hour elapsed deadline, lawful release, eligible source ending or all panels destroyed. Ending removes only prison matter/expressions; target and genuine gear remain at their actual current location. No corpse disappearance or resurrection.
lifecycle.growth: if a legitimate body change would overlap active prison panels, end prison before settling the changed body; never crush or cancel another legal form silently
lifecycle.suppression: only covered panels inactive; original deadline continues. On resumption, if any panel volume is occupied, end the entire prison safely instead of inserting it through bodies/items. Destroyed/ended panels never resume.
lifecycle.recast: same-target active source known at admission rejects another prison of this identity before cost. Different owners do not bypass that guard; race revalidated at paid resolution. Separate external effects remain independent.
lifecycle.escapeAfterOpening: target moves using its real movement budget and swept fit; ending creates no free step, Action or rescue teleport
lifecycle.death: original corpse and gear remain where death occurred; the cell may continue but never claims a soul or reusable summoned corpse

fixture.support: test-floor continuous below entire footprint; no new embedded slab
